Our sites

Camps, clinics, schools and other places you look after. Rainfall is Open-Meteo's model forecast for each point over the next 7 days, screened at 10 mm and 25 mm a day. It is not an official warning.

Community reports

Public reports from residents, after the site's review. Your stage and note are shared only with your organisation and do not change the public report.

Field records

Observations your teams collect. Use the form for one record, or import a CSV from ODK or KoboToolbox. Each record stays unverified.

Import a CSV

Up to 500 rows at a time. Columns are matched by name; KoboToolbox group prefixes and its _uuid column are understood. A row with the same record_id, or the same place, category and description within an hour, is skipped as a duplicate. Put an earlier record_id in the corrects column to correct it.
